title: Taking a sensory break
examples: My body feels too much or too little
What can I do in a sensory break?

explain.say: Sometimes your body feels too busy and full of energy. Sometimes it feels too tired and slow. A sensory break can help. Your senses are how you see, hear, touch, taste, smell and move. Look at the board.
This group is calm me down. It has soft music, dim lights and a wall push. It has slow breaths and a cosy blanket. These help a busy body slow down. Do you ever feel too busy?
This group is wake me up. You can do ten jumps or a fast walk. You can sip cold water or eat a crunchy snack. These help a tired body wake up. Which one would you pick?
First, ask yourself, What does my body need? A busy body needs calm me down. A tired body needs wake me up. Then pick one thing. Which group do you need right now?
This is a now and next board. Now is a five-minute sensory break. Next is back to work. You can say, Can I have a sensory break, please? Today, find one calm move and one wake-up move you like.

faq.q: How long is a sensory break?
faq.a: Usually about five minutes. A timer helps you know when to go back.
asks: Tell me about Now: sensory break

faq.q: How do I ask for a sensory break?
faq.a: You can say, Can I have a sensory break, please? Or show a break card. A grown-up you trust can help you plan.
asks: Tell me about Next: back to work

faq.a: Slow and heavy things help. Try soft music, dim lights, a wall push, slow breaths or a cosy blanket.
asks: Tell me about Calm me down

faq.a: Quick, fresh things: jumps, a cold water sip, a crunchy snack or a fast walk.
asks: Tell me about Wake me up

faq.a: Senses are how your body learns about the world. They are seeing, hearing, touching, tasting and smelling. Your body also feels movement and balance.

facts: Besides the five well-known senses, the body also senses balance and the position of its own parts.
Pushing, pulling and carrying heavy things give the muscles strong input, which many people find calming.

quiz.say: Kofi's body feels too busy. Which move can help him slow down?
quiz.show: Kofi feels too busy. Which move helps him slow down?
quiz.why: A wall push is heavy work for the muscles. It can help a busy body slow down.

wrong.0: Fast jumps wake a body up, and Kofi needs to slow down.
wrong.2: A crunchy snack wakes a body up, and Kofi needs to slow down.

quiz.say: Mei feels sleepy in class. Which move can help her feel awake?
quiz.show: 😴 Mei feels sleepy. Which move helps her feel awake?
quiz.why: Jumping gets the heart and muscles working. Mei's body feels more awake.

wrong.0: Dim lights help a body calm down, so Mei may feel sleepier.
wrong.1: Soft music helps a body calm down, so Mei may feel sleepier.
